sources.name: GOV.SA National Platform Events
sources.coverage: Government platform index for Saudi public events, government-entity events, public consultations, ministries, organizer contact fields, date windows, locations, registration links, and related official detail pages.
sources.evidence_required: GOV.SA event detail URL such as https://my.gov.sa/ar/events/{id}, indexed search evidence, or an approved GOV.SA/NEC feed. Do not rely on direct scraping of the protected listing page.
sources.notes: Added 2026-07-09 after probing https://my.gov.sa/ar/events. Direct curl and browser access returned a Cloudflare challenge, so this is not promotable for automated scraping. Public search indexes expose detail URLs and useful fields including title, organizer, date range, location/contact, category, description, image, and registration/share links. Deeper recon found useful non-scraping lanes: Wayback archived-page radar with embedded Next/Drupal payload fields, DGA open-data/API governance, Istitlaa public-consultation confirmation links, and NEC National Calendar services as the likely authoritative backend lane. Second pass found the NEC Angular app catalog includes Add Event, View National Calendar Events, and National Calendar Dashboard; View National Calendar Events is the best export/API partnership ask. Treat GOV.SA as a partnership/evidence source and use indexed or archived detail pages only for manual review or official-source corroboration. See reports/mygov-platform-recon-2026-07-09.md, reports/mygov-platform-recon-second-pass-2026-07-09.md, and reports/mygov-wayback-radar.md.
